g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
$ /bin/bash -c curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt -o /workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs-index.txt; rg -i 'credit|billing|usage|c
ost|spend' /workspace/mcpjam-eval/docs-index.txt; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
s=json.load(open('/workspace/mcpjam-eval/openapi.json'))
print(json.dumps(s['paths']['/organizations/{organizationId}/spend-budget'],indent=1))
PY
- [Slack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and approv
e the actions that spend credits
- [host-compat](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/host-compat.md): API reference for @mcpjam/sdk/host-compat — derive server r
equirements, evaluate host compatibility, and scan widget bridge usage.
- [List run iterations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iterations.md): Per-iteration results: actual too
l calls, structured token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.
- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `POST /pro
jects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: "failed_cases"` would execute, before anything spends. The platform select
s every case with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trials do not count. `reasons` and `excluded` co
unt trials; `selectedCase…
- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-h
osted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization
's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md
): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer
. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not co
mpleted usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…
- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Th
e ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billi
ng window, and how much of it has been spent.
- [Set the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Set
or replace the ceiling. **Requires organization owner or admin.**
- [Remove the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-spend-budget.md)
: Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires organization owner or admin.**
- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs
to — the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one o
rganization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.
- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credit
s are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` r
equest ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.
- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spe
nds.** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.
- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial fo
r anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field. These caps only mean something as a set, and a partial update that ra
ised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.
- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's
sessions used.
- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.
md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the orga
nization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here ta
kes one from there.
- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/get-a-connection-request.md): Current state
of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather than the shared per-caller one, so polling on a short interval is
expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 429 here means the poll interval itself is too fast; honour Retry
-After.
- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The determi
nistic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.
- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-read
iness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The t
arget comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll t
he run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…
- [Start a Muse connector readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-muse-connector-readines
s-run.md): Grades the saved server against Meta's Muse connector guidelines and returns `202` with a run id. Free: Muse readiness
has no AI observations, so the body has no field that can spend, and no submission mode, which belongs to the OpenAI plugin direct
ory. The submission-ready verdict stays `incomplete…
- [Send one agent Playground message](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/send-one-agent-playground-message.md): S
end one message to a project's MCP servers and get the model's reply plus the telemetry a participant in the conversation could no
t see: which tools ran, with what arguments, what each returned, per-call latency, and token usage.
- [Read a chat session's execution trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/read-a-chat-sessions-execution-trace
